verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 116.5 (-2.8% in a day) and momentum is 41: prices are falling. 84s cost 800, 85s 2,400 and 86s 4,800. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-01T08:06:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Sveindís Jane Jónsdóttir 86 Ultimate Scream after its 58% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 45,750 coins. Now 46,750. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 58.4% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +2.8% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Taylor Flint 85 Ultimate Scream after its 12% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 70,500 coins. Now 52,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 11.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 4 so far, averaging +2.8% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 800 (0.96 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,400 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,800 (1.17 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,900 (1.25 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,750 (1.54 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Ruben Aguilar and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Ruben Aguilar 77 Rare -63.6%; Franco Ibarra 75 Rare -60.0%; Álex Moreno 76 Rare -58.0%; Laura Pérez 85 Ultimate Scream -56.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
